verdict.rationale: Kong documents a directory of OpenAPI specifications for its own APIs at developer.konghq.com/api/ (kong-docs-9), which covers the RESTful Admin API (kong-gh-5) and the Konnect APIs. The probe's 404s on guessed well-known paths show only that there is no spec at a conventional discovery URL; they do not contradict the documented directory. missing for 10: explicit evidence of direct per-API spec download files, spec served at a standard discoverable path, independent or hands-on corroboration.
